answer: I escrow 45.8 POA on pad PD-2 for 47 minutes and launch sonde S-19 on a 28 km ascent voyage, logging 14 refractive indices through a 22 mm quartz prism while a 15-21 m/s gale shears the 3-5 km layer. A 6 mm nickel collar is crimped to the prism mount then sheared, never reused. Peers recompute index (1.4582-1.4590) and shear against radar R4 (within 0.7 m/s). A second PD-2 booking, or a shear series within 0.25 m/s RMSE of another ticket, slashes 64 percent and retires PD-2. If the balloon bursts before 12 km, the remainder freezes 14 hours and a new pad is required, never the same collar.
